description: This PHP class 'BuzzLikeOnComment' is part of the OrangeHRM system, representing a 'like' on a comment within a social or messaging feature. It defines properties such as the comment that was liked, the employee who liked it, and the timestamp of the 'like'. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping, and traits for datetime handling and decorators.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnComment
classes.description: An entity class representing a 'like' on a comment within the OrangeHRM system, including properties for comment, employee, and timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the like record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the like record.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the associated comment that was liked.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Associates a comment with this like.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who liked the comment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who liked the comment.

methods.name: getLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of when the comment was liked (in UTC).

methods.name: setLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the liked timestamp to the current UTC time.
